LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Enlist_Letter_Title: In service to the Snow Elves
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now serves the Snow Elf Empire. The knight-paladins will feed and pay those who keep faith with Auri-El.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Enlist_Button_Desc: Offer the colony's service to the Snow Elves and their knight-paladins.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Enlist_Requrements_No: The Snow Elves are not sure of you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Enlisted_To_Hostile_F: The Snow Elves will not accept the service of their enemies.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Missions_Desc: See what the chantry needs done.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Menu_Missions_Desc: Tasks from the Chantry of Auri-El. Paid when finished.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Provisions_Desc: Rations and herbs from the chantry.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in a Snow Elf chantry.

LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Resign_Button_Desc: End your service to the Snow Elves.
LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Snow Elves have turned the colony away.

LanguageData.ESCP_SnowElfEmpire_Work_1_Desc: Learn the sword and the bow from the chantry's knights.
